about: Every caps command and option and its place in CAPS Studio (and the C API entry points the Studio calls). An option is 'page' (on the command's page, the anchor of the command), FILE|TEXT (a Studio file under studio/CapsStudio and a text it must contain), 'partial: why' or 'cli: why' (no Studio control, and why). shared: the Studio calls the same command layer. tests/test_cli_gui_sync.py fails when the CLI gains a command or option this file does not place.

exchange.where: Views/Pages/ExchangePage.axaml|Bond exchange · vitrimers and self-healing networks
